analysis: The PR only changes CHANGELOG.md. It adds one 'Unreleased' entry (lines 3-5 in head) saying `darkbloom update` and `darkbloom restart` re-arm the watchdog when a relaunch of the drained provider fails. No source, tests, or configuration are included in the supplied units. The entry describes a provider CLI lifecycle behavior change, which probably touches the T-043 area (watchdog rollback authority, crash recovery) and TB-003. The security effect of that change cannot be assessed from this diff because the code change is not supplied. The entry adds no new attack surface, auth, attestation, or encryption behavior, and does not contradict the TB-009 or TB-011 assumptions. Findings: none. Coverage limit: the actual watchdog code change was not provided. A later pass should check that re-arming the watchdog after a failed relaunch does not trigger false rollbacks or restart loops (T-043 DoS) and that the reported error is preserved.
